sentence: She edited the anthologies On Our Backs: The Best Erotic Fiction (2004) and Bottoms Up: Writing About Sex (Soft Skull Press, 2004).
context: Earlier titles include Girl Meets Girl: A Dating Survival Guide (2009), Threeways: Fulfill Your Ultimate Fantasy (2006), the IPPY Award–nominated Box Lunch: A Layperson's Guide to Cunnilingus (2004), and The On Our Backs Guide to Lesbian Sex (2004). She edited the anthologies On Our Backs: The Best Erotic Fiction (2004) and Bottoms Up: Writing About Sex (Soft Skull Press, 2004).
